rules.title: AWS Access Key ID
rules.description: AWS Access Key IDs can be used to make API calls to AWS services.
rules.recommendation: Use AWS IAM roles, environment variables, or AWS Secrets Manager.

rules.title: AWS Secret Access Key
rules.description: AWS Secret Access Keys provide full API access when combined with an access key ID.
rules.recommendation: Rotate the exposed key immediately and use environment variables.

rules.title: GitHub Personal Access Token
rules.description: GitHub tokens can access repositories and organization data.
rules.recommendation: Revoke the token and use GitHub App installations or CI/CD secrets.

rules.title: GitHub OAuth Secret
rules.description: GitHub OAuth client secrets should be kept confidential.
rules.recommendation: Store OAuth secrets in environment variables or a secrets manager.

rules.title: Google API Key
rules.description: Google API keys can be used for various Google Cloud services.
rules.recommendation: Restrict the API key in Google Cloud Console to specific APIs/IPs.

rules.title: Google OAuth Client Secret
rules.description: Google OAuth client secrets enable OAuth flow impersonation.
rules.recommendation: Store in environment variables or Google Secret Manager.

rules.title: Stripe Secret Key (Live)
rules.description: Stripe secret keys provide full access to your Stripe account.
rules.recommendation: Rotate the key immediately and use restricted API keys.

rules.title: Stripe Secret Key (Test)
rules.description: Stripe test secret keys expose test API access.
rules.recommendation: Use environment variables even for test keys.

rules.title: Slack API Token
rules.description: Slack tokens provide access to Slack workspaces.
rules.recommendation: Revoke the token and use environment variables.

rules.title: Slack Webhook URL
rules.description: Slack incoming webhook URLs allow posting messages to channels.
rules.recommendation: Rotate the webhook URL and store as a secret.

rules.title: Twilio API Key
rules.description: Twilio API keys can send SMS, make calls, and access account data.
rules.recommendation: Rotate the key in Twilio Console.

rules.title: SendGrid API Key
rules.description: SendGrid API keys enable sending emails on behalf of your account.
rules.recommendation: Rotate the key and restrict permissions.

rules.title: Mailgun API Key
rules.description: Mailgun API keys provide email sending access.
rules.recommendation: Rotate the key in Mailgun Dashboard.

rules.title: OpenAI API Key
rules.description: OpenAI API keys can incur significant costs if abused.
rules.recommendation: Rotate the key and use environment variables.

rules.title: OpenAI Project API Key
rules.description: OpenAI project-scoped API keys can access all project resources.
rules.recommendation: Rotate the key and store securely.

rules.title: Heroku API Key
rules.description: Heroku API keys provide full account access.
rules.recommendation: Regenerate the key in Heroku Account Settings.

rules.title: JWT Secret Key
rules.description: JWT secret keys can be used to forge authentication tokens.
rules.recommendation: Use a strong random key and store in environment variables.

rules.title: Firebase API Key
rules.description: Firebase API keys identify your Firebase project.
rules.recommendation: Add API key restrictions in Firebase Console.

rules.title: Hardcoded Password Assignment
rules.description: A password is hardcoded directly in source code.
rules.recommendation: Use environment variables or a secrets manager.

rules.title: Database Password in Connection String
rules.description: Database connection strings with embedded passwords.
rules.recommendation: Use credential injection from environment or secrets manager.

rules.title: Private Key
rules.description: Private cryptographic keys are exposed in source code.
rules.recommendation: Remove immediately and generate new keys. Store in a vault.

rules.title: Generic API Key Assignment
rules.description: A generic API key or token was found hardcoded.
rules.recommendation: Move to environment variables or a secrets manager.

rules.title: NPM Token
rules.description: NPM automation tokens can publish packages.
rules.recommendation: Regenerate the token in NPM settings.

rules.title: PyPI API Token
rules.description: PyPI API tokens can publish Python packages.
rules.recommendation: Delete the token and create a new one on PyPI.

rules.title: Docker Hub Access Token
rules.description: Docker Hub access tokens can push/pull images.
rules.recommendation: Regenerate the token in Docker Hub account settings.

rules.title: Azure Storage Connection String
rules.description: Azure Storage connection strings with account key.
rules.recommendation: Use managed identities or SAS tokens instead.

rules.title: Discord Bot Token
rules.description: Discord bot tokens can control Discord bots.
rules.recommendation: Regenerate the token in Discord Developer Portal.

rules.title: TLS Certificate
rules.description: TLS certificates exposed in source code.
rules.recommendation: Store certificates in a secure location.

rules.title: Bearer Token in Code
rules.description: Bearer authentication tokens found in source code.
rules.recommendation: Use OAuth flows or environment variables.
